INSERT INTO comments (id, post_id, reply_to_id, reply_to_floor, author_id, floor, body,
                                   is_anonymous, anonymous_seed)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, (SELECT floor FROM comments WHERE id = $3), $4, $7, $5, $6,
                     CASE WHEN $6 THEN 'seed' END)
